description: Implementation of BufferVk class and related buffer management functions for Vulkan in ANGLE project, including buffer creation, data setting, copying, mapping, and conversion buffer handling.

classes.name: ConversionBuffer
classes.description: Helper class for buffer data conversion, managing buffer data and state.

classes.name: BufferVk::VertexConversionBuffer
classes.description: Specialized conversion buffer for vertex data with specific format, stride, and offset.

classes.name: BufferVk
classes.description: Vulkan buffer implementation for ANGLE, managing buffer creation, data transfer, mapping, copying, and conversion buffers.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases buffer resources associated with the context.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases internal buffer and conversion buffers.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, recreating buffer if size exceeds current capacity.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data at a specified offset.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer into this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the entire buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: mapImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for mapping the entire buffer.

methods.name: mapRangeImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for mapping a range of the buffer.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: unmapImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for unmapping the buffer.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing elements.

methods.name: setDataImpl
methods.description: Internal method to set buffer data, using staging buffers if needed.

methods.name: copyToBuffer
methods.description: Copies buffer data to another buffer.

methods.name: getVertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex conversion buffer with specific format, stride, and offset.

methods.name: markConversionBuffersDirty
methods.description: Marks all conversion buffers as dirty, indicating data has changed.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Marks conversion buffers as dirty when buffer data changes.
